record.question: The height of a Pressed steel tank will be multiples of
record.explanation: IS 804 (Rectangular Pressed Steel Tanks) fixes the module: clause 6.1 says the size of tanks shall be specified as multiples of the nominal dimensions of 1.25 m (unit plate 1.25 m square; 1.25 x 1.25 x 1.25 m = 1950 litres), and clause 6.2 says pressed mild steel tanks shall be either 1.25 m, 2.50 m, 3.75 m or 5.00 m deep, i.e. the tank height (depth) is always a multiple of 1.25 m. Verified against the standard text (IS 804:1967, archive.org/law.resource.org) and the printed source page 6 of the 2016 JE (Civil) Paper II, which reads exactly as in the bank item.
